## Prerequisites

Load environment variables before running commands:

```{bash}
source ../env/load_env.sh
```

## Build Lambda Function w/ECR

### ECR Repo

- Create repo

```{bash eval=FALSE}

aws ecr create-repository --repository-name ${ECR_REPOSITORY_NAME} --profile ${AWS_PROFILE} --region ${AWS_REGION_LAMBDA}

```

#### DuckDB Test Lambda

```{bash eval=FALSE}

aws ecr get-login-password --region ${AWS_REGION_LAMBDA} --profile ${AWS_PROFILE} | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin ${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_LAMBDA}.dkr.ecr.${AWS_REGION_LAMBDA}.amazonaws.com 

```
```{bash eval=FALSE}

docker build -t duckdb-tester -f Dockerfile.duckdb_test .

```

```{bash eval=FALSE}

docker tag duckdb-tester:latest ${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_LAMBDA}.dkr.ecr.${AWS_REGION_LAMBDA}.amazonaws.com/${ECR_REPOSITORY_NAME}:${ECR_IMAGE_TAG}

```

```{bash eval=FALSE}

docker push ${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_LAMBDA}.dkr.ecr.${AWS_REGION_LAMBDA}.amazonaws.com/${ECR_REPOSITORY_NAME}:${ECR_IMAGE_TAG}

```

### Create Function

```{bash}

aws lambda create-function \
    --function-name ${LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME} \
    --code ImageUri=${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_LAMBDA}.dkr.ecr.${AWS_REGION_LAMBDA}.amazonaws.com/${ECR_REPOSITORY_NAME}:${ECR_IMAGE_TAG} \
    --role ${LAMBDA_ROLE_ARN} \
    --package-type Image \
    --publish \
    --timeout 900 \
    --memory-size 256 \
    --region ${AWS_REGION_LAMBDA} \
    --profile ${AWS_PROFILE}


```

### Update Function

```{bash eval=FALSE}

aws ecr get-login-password --region ${AWS_REGION_LAMBDA} --profile ${AWS_PROFILE} | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin ${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_LAMBDA}.dkr.ecr.${AWS_REGION_LAMBDA}.amazonaws.com 

```

```{bash eval=FALSE}

docker build -t duckdb-tester -f Dockerfile.duckdb_test .

```

```{bash eval=FALSE}

docker tag duckdb-tester:latest ${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_LAMBDA}.dkr.ecr.${AWS_REGION_LAMBDA}.amazonaws.com/${ECR_REPOSITORY_NAME}:${ECR_IMAGE_TAG}

```

```{bash eval=FALSE}

docker push ${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_LAMBDA}.dkr.ecr.${AWS_REGION_LAMBDA}.amazonaws.com/${ECR_REPOSITORY_NAME}:${ECR_IMAGE_TAG}

```

```{bash eval=FALSE}

aws lambda update-function-code \
    --function-name ${LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME} \
    --image-uri ${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID_LAMBDA}.dkr.ecr.${AWS_REGION_LAMBDA}.amazonaws.com/${ECR_REPOSITORY_NAME}:${ECR_IMAGE_TAG} \
    --publish \
    --region ${AWS_REGION_LAMBDA} \
    --profile ${AWS_PROFILE}

```
